questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to successful implant planning?' Mina replies:
options: A CBCT analysis with 3D bone assessment
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'CBCT is the reference tool for 3D bone volume assessment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always prescribe a CBCT.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to assess bone density?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The Misch classification assesses bone density from D1 (very dense) to D4 (very low density).' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use this classification.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the safety distance from the inferior alveolar nerve?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The recommended safety distance is 2 mm above the mandibular canal.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always check this distance.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of surgical guides?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Surgical guides allow precise and safe placement.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use guides systematically.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is primary stability in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: The immediate mechanical fixation of the implant in the bone
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Primary stability is essential for osseointegration.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always check primary stability.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What factors influence osseointegration?' Mina replies:
options: Bone quality, implant surface, loading, hygiene
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Osseointegration depends on multiple factors.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will take all these factors into account.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should we use a short implant?' Mina replies:
options: In cases of severe bone atrophy
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Short implants (< 8mm) are an alternative to bone grafts.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer short implants for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of peri-implantitis?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Peri-implantitis manifests with inflammatory signs and bone loss.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor these signs.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is immediate loading?' Mina replies:
options: The placement of a provisional crown within 48 hours of implant placement
The placement of the implant without surgery
The placement of a definitive crown the same day
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Immediate loading is possible in selected cases with excellent primary stability.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will select cases carefully.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risks of occlusal overload on an implant?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Overload can compromise the longevity of the implant.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always balance the occlusion.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is guided bone regeneration in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: A technique using membranes to regenerate bone
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'GBR allows regeneration of bone lost around the implant.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in GBR.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an early implant failure?' Mina replies:
options: Remove the implant, analyze the causes, wait for healing
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Early failure requires analysis and a redo.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will remove and analyze.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of zirconia implants?' Mina replies:
options: Better aesthetics, absence of metal, biocompatibility
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Zirconia implants offer superior aesthetics and absence of metal.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will offer zirconia implants.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the criteria for implant success?' Mina replies:
options: No pain, no mobility, bone loss < 1.5mm in the first year
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Success criteria are multiple and validated by the literature.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate all these criteria.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is implant maintenance?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Maintenance is essential for the longevity of implants.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan regular check-ups.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risk factors for peri-implantitis?' Mina replies:
options: Smoking, diabetes, poor hygiene, history of periodontitis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Risk factors are multiple and must be taken into account.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will assess risk factors.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a block graft in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: A bone graft harvested in block and fixed with screws
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The block graft is used for large bone defects.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to a specialist.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an oro-sinusal communication after extraction?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Oro-sinusal communication requires surgical closure.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to a surgeon.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the crestal sinus lift?' Mina replies:
options: A technique to increase maxillary bone via the crest
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The crestal sinus lift is a minimally invasive technique.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use this technique for small defects.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What bone graft materials are available?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Materials are multiple with advantages and disadvantages.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will choose the appropriate material.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is delayed loading in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: The placement of the crown after 3-6 months
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Delayed loading is the standard protocol for the majority of cases.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will wait the necessary time.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an implant fracture?' Mina replies:
options: Remove the implant and assess the possibility of redoing
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Fracture is a rare but serious complication.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will remove the fractured implant.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of reverse planning in implantology?' Mina replies:
options: The prosthesis guides the implant positioning
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Reverse planning (prosthesis first) is the reference.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always plan the prosthesis first.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of late implant failure?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Late failures are often related to long-term problems.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor these signs.'

questions.question: Sami, after mastering implant planning with Mina, says: 'I'm ready to take on all challenges!' Mina concludes: 'Mastering planning is...'
options: The foundation of success in implantology
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastering planning is the foundation of success in implantology.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to train.'
